commandResults.notes: Created media asset, storage object, and upload job.
Smoke passed but processing status remained retrying/processing.
Publication smoke completed and full song stayed private.
Sandboxed run failed with local listen EPERM; unsandboxed run passed.
Uses mocked R2-style environment values; live provider unverified.
Redis false, workers disabled, ffmpeg false, ffprobe false, image processor false.
Large chunk and TanStack directive warnings.

findings.title: Frontend admin route guard is an authentication bypass
findings.description: AdminProtectedRoute always allows access.
findings.evidence: isAdminAccessAllowed returns true and comments say auth will be connected later.
findings.currentBehavior: Admin UI renders without identity verification.
findings.requiredProductionBehavior: Verified admin identity and role guard before rendering admin routes.
findings.recommendedFix: Implement production admin auth, route guard, login/logout, roles, and session handling.
findings.verificationMethod: Attempt unauthenticated /admin access and verify redirect/401.

findings.title: Backend admin API uses shared dev token and auth-disabled bypass
findings.description: MediaAuthorizationService accepts MEDIA_AUTH_DISABLED or a shared dev token and returns broad dev-admin permissions.
findings.evidence: process.env.MEDIA_AUTH_DISABLED === true or token equals mediaBackendConfig.devAdminToken grants permissions.
findings.currentBehavior: Shared token grants all admin media/publication permissions.
findings.requiredProductionBehavior: Real authenticated principal with persisted roles and token/session policy.
findings.recommendedFix: Replace dev token auth and block auth-disabled/default token in production.
findings.verificationMethod: Production env startup fails for default dev token; protected API rejects unauthenticated requests.

findings.title: No production database or migration system
findings.description: Media persistence uses a JSON file and there are no migrations or DB dependencies.
findings.evidence: JsonDatabase writes server/data/media-db.json; no migration directory or DB package found.
findings.currentBehavior: JSON file persistence with cache and full-file writes.
findings.requiredProductionBehavior: Durable DB with migrations, constraints, indexes, concurrency safety, backup/restore.
findings.recommendedFix: Add production database schema and migrate all domain persistence.
findings.verificationMethod: Run migrations and CRUD integration tests against a real DB.

findings.title: Core admin CRUD is seed-backed and in-memory
findings.description: Artist, release, media, gallery, metadata, site config, preview, linking, and audit services use SeedBacked or InMemory implementations.
findings.evidence: SeedBackedAdminArtistService initializes private records from publicArtistsSeed.
findings.currentBehavior: Admin changes live only in frontend memory and seed-derived records.
findings.requiredProductionBehavior: Authenticated API mutations backed by database records.
findings.recommendedFix: Create backend CRUD APIs and replace SeedBacked admin services with API clients.
findings.verificationMethod: Reload after create/edit and confirm persisted backend record.

findings.title: Public delivery backend still serves seed data
findings.description: Public artist/release services import frontend seed data rather than reading published DB projections.
findings.evidence: server/services/public/PublicArtistService.ts and PublicReleaseService.ts import ../../../src/data.
findings.requiredProductionBehavior: Only published synchronized records from persistence are exposed.
findings.recommendedFix: Implement public projection persistence and remove server imports from src/data.
findings.verificationMethod: Publish DB record and verify public API reflects it without seed import.

findings.title: Media processing is readiness-only
findings.description: Derivative, blur, audio transcode, and waveform processing do not produce real launch outputs.
findings.evidence: Image derivative processor returns skipped outputs because Sharp is not installed; audio transcode skips/fails without ffmpeg.
findings.currentBehavior: Processing jobs create readiness records, not production derivatives/transcodes.
findings.requiredProductionBehavior: Real processed files and metadata persisted to storage/database.
findings.recommendedFix: Wire sharp and ffmpeg/ffprobe or managed processor services.
findings.verificationMethod: Upload image/audio and assert derivative/audio output objects exist.

findings.title: No durable production queue infrastructure
findings.description: Queue registry is in-process and health reports Redis unavailable and workers disabled.
findings.evidence: MediaQueueRegistry stores queues in arrays; media:queue:health reports redisConnected false.
findings.currentBehavior: Jobs are process-local and workers run only when script is invoked.
findings.requiredProductionBehavior: Durable queue backend and deployed workers with retries/dead-letter monitoring.
findings.recommendedFix: Add Redis/BullMQ or equivalent and worker process deployment.
findings.verificationMethod: Restart API and verify queued jobs persist and workers process them.

findings.title: No deployment or operations baseline
findings.description: No Docker, CI, env template, migration command, worker deployment, backup, restore, monitoring, or alert configuration was found.
findings.evidence: Repository inventory found package files and docs only; no deployment artifacts.
findings.requiredProductionBehavior: Repeatable deployment, configuration, health checks, logs, metrics, backups, rollback.
findings.recommendedFix: Create deployment/ops baseline and CI gates.
findings.verificationMethod: Deploy staging from CI and pass smoke/health/rollback checks.

findings.title: Storage defaults to local/mock and live provider is unverified
findings.description: R2/S3 adapter structure exists but production storage smoke uses mocked values and default provider is local.
findings.evidence: mediaBackendConfig provider fallback is local; production-storage smoke sets test R2 values.
findings.verificationMethod: Live upload/download/signed URL/delete test against production bucket.

findings.title: Seed fallback can mask public API absence in development
findings.description: PublicMediaApiClient falls back to seed-backed services when API base is missing or request fails and seed fallback is enabled.
findings.evidence: seedFallbackEnabled defaults to import.meta.env.DEV.
findings.verificationMethod: Production build with fallback disabled fails loudly when API is unavailable.

findings.title: Many admin actions are disabled placeholders
findings.description: Multiple admin row, toolbar, and form actions are rendered disabled without production implementation.
findings.evidence: rg found disabled admin actions for archive/restore/copy URL/assign/open public/settings/SEO/export/reorder.
findings.verificationMethod: Manual and e2e admin workflow tests for each action.

findings.title: Contact/newsletter workflows are static or disabled
findings.description: ContactService returns delayed static config; newsletter component is placeholder with disabled input/button.
findings.evidence: ContactService uses delay and defaultContactConfig; NewsletterPlaceholder says signup coming soon.
findings.verificationMethod: Submit contact/newsletter forms and verify persistence/email/consent.

findings.title: Frontend VITE media admin token exposure risk
findings.description: Frontend admin API clients read VITE_MEDIA_ADMIN_DEV_TOKEN, which would be bundled if set for production.
findings.evidence: Upload and admin API clients read import.meta.env.VITE_MEDIA_ADMIN_DEV_TOKEN.
findings.verificationMethod: Production bundle contains no admin token and uses secure session/cookie auth.

findings.title: Custom multipart parser is not production hardened
findings.description: Parser buffers full request and splits by boundary manually.
findings.evidence: parseMultipartRequest accumulates chunks and parses body as binary string.
findings.verificationMethod: Streaming upload tests for large files, malformed boundaries, and memory ceilings.

findings.title: Missing backend APIs for non-media admin domains
findings.description: No backend route inventory for artists, releases, gallery, homepage, SEO, settings, users/roles, contact, newsletter, or analytics ingestion.
findings.evidence: adminMediaRoutes only includes media/publication routes.
findings.verificationMethod: Route inventory includes authenticated CRUD endpoints and integration tests.

findings.title: Security middleware gaps
findings.description: No evidence of rate limiting, security headers, CORS policy, CSRF protection, brute-force handling, or production error stack policy.
findings.evidence: Native http server registers route handlers directly.
findings.verificationMethod: Security header/rate/CSRF/auth failure tests pass.

findings.title: CDN invalidation is readiness-only
findings.description: CDN processor records readiness rather than calling a provider purge API.
findings.evidence: cdnInvalidationProcessor is a simple output mapper.
findings.verificationMethod: Provider invalidation API called and stale asset removed from CDN.

findings.title: Media replace/version system is not fully backend-integrated
findings.description: Frontend/admin components and models exist, but no complete backend replace endpoint was found in route inventory.
findings.evidence: Admin media routes include asset patch/archive/delete/storage actions, not replace file/version rollback endpoints.
findings.verificationMethod: Replace file through API, verify old version retained and public URL safety preserved.

findings.title: Expected public pages are missing
findings.description: About, privacy, and terms routes are expected in audit scope but absent from AppRouter.
findings.evidence: AppRouter public route list does not include /about, /privacy, /terms.
findings.verificationMethod: Routes render with SEO/footer/nav and legal content.

findings.title: Analytics providers are no-op/future placeholders
findings.description: Google, Plausible, PostHog, and custom API adapters extend a placeholder that resolves without sending.
findings.evidence: FutureProviderPlaceholder sendEvent returns Promise.resolve().
findings.verificationMethod: Analytics event reaches configured provider in staging.

findings.title: No lint/unit/e2e/accessibility coverage gates
findings.description: Package scripts include smoke checks but not lint, unit test, integration test, e2e test, accessibility test, or coverage.
findings.evidence: package.json scripts list lacks lint/test/e2e/a11y coverage commands.
findings.verificationMethod: CI runs lint, unit, integration, e2e, a11y, and coverage gates.

findings.title: Search and browse are not indexed production queries
findings.description: Public search/browse operate over service/seed data rather than indexed persistence.
findings.verificationMethod: Search uses DB indexes, pagination, and public-only filters.

findings.title: Production bundle and image sizes need optimization
findings.description: Build emits 855.56 kB main JS chunk and multiple 2 MB+ images.
findings.verificationMethod: Bundle/image budgets pass in CI.

findings.title: Missing production backend dependencies
findings.description: Dependencies are frontend-focused; no DB, Redis/BullMQ, sharp, ffmpeg wrapper, email, logging, rate-limit, schema validation, or auth libraries are installed.
findings.verificationMethod: Required production packages installed and used in runtime paths.

findings.title: Shared httpClient is a placeholder
findings.description: httpClient methods return server_error instead of issuing requests.
findings.evidence: src/services/api/httpClient.ts returns HTTP client is not configured yet.
findings.verificationMethod: Either replace with real client or remove unused placeholder.

findings.title: No backup/restore strategy
findings.description: No backup scripts, storage recovery workflow, database restore drill, or media object retention verification were found.
findings.verificationMethod: Restore drill proves DB and media can be recovered.

remediationItems.title: Production authentication and authorization
remediationItems.description: Replace frontend/backend admin bypasses with real auth, roles, sessions, and hardening.
implementationRequirements: No default dev token in production
verificationSteps: Default dev token rejected in production
remediationItems.definitionOfDone: Admin UI/API are inaccessible without a verified production admin session.

remediationItems.title: Production database and admin CRUD
remediationItems.description: Add database schema/migrations and backend CRUD for core admin records.
remediationItems.definitionOfDone: Core content persists through backend DB APIs.

remediationItems.title: Public projection and seed removal
remediationItems.description: Public API uses published DB projections only and production fallback is disabled.
verificationSteps: Seed files can be removed from server path
remediationItems.definitionOfDone: Public API is database-backed and production-safe.

remediationItems.title: Upload and storage hardening
remediationItems.description: Replace custom multipart parser, verify live storage, and enforce production storage config.
remediationItems.definitionOfDone: Uploads are persistent, safe, and live-provider verified.

remediationItems.title: Real media processing
remediationItems.description: Generate real image/audio outputs with sharp and ffmpeg/ffprobe or managed processing providers.
verificationSteps: Upload media and assert output storage objects
remediationItems.definitionOfDone: Processing outputs are real and usable by public/admin pages.

remediationItems.title: Durable queues and workers
remediationItems.description: Replace in-process queue fallback with durable queue infrastructure and deployed workers.
remediationItems.definitionOfDone: Job processing survives process restarts and is observable.

remediationItems.title: Provider-backed CDN invalidation
remediationItems.description: Connect CDN purge/invalidation APIs and verify stale public media is removed.
verificationSteps: Verify old URL no longer serves stale content
remediationItems.definitionOfDone: CDN invalidation is provider-backed and verified.

remediationItems.title: Backend media replace and rollback
remediationItems.description: Add backend replacement and rollback endpoints that preserve versions and public URL safety.
remediationItems.definitionOfDone: Media replacement and rollback are server-backed and safe for published pages.

remediationItems.title: Complete admin workflow actions
remediationItems.description: Replace disabled admin placeholder actions with real authenticated backend mutations.
verificationSteps: Admin e2e workflow coverage for each domain
remediationItems.definitionOfDone: No production-required admin action remains disabled without a real workflow.

remediationItems.title: Contact and newsletter production workflow
remediationItems.description: Implement contact submissions, newsletter consent, duplicate handling, email/provider integration, spam controls, and admin review.
remediationItems.definitionOfDone: Contact and newsletter are functional production workflows.

remediationItems.title: Public route completeness
remediationItems.description: Add expected public about, privacy, and terms routes with SEO metadata and navigation/footer integration.

remediationItems.title: Analytics production integration
remediationItems.description: Replace analytics placeholders with a selected provider or explicitly disabled production policy.
verificationSteps: Track page and media events in staging and verify provider receipt
remediationItems.definitionOfDone: Analytics behavior is intentional, verified, and privacy-aligned.

remediationItems.title: Testing, lint, e2e, and accessibility gates
remediationItems.description: Add automated lint, unit, integration, e2e, accessibility, and coverage gates.
verificationSteps: Run CI locally or in staging and verify all gates pass
remediationItems.definitionOfDone: Launch-critical workflows have automated quality gates.

remediationItems.title: Performance budget and asset optimization
remediationItems.description: Reduce large chunks and oversized image assets, then enforce budgets.
verificationSteps: Production build under agreed JS/image budgets

remediationItems.title: Production dependency finalization
remediationItems.description: Install and use required production backend dependencies for DB, queues, processing, validation, email, security, logging, and monitoring.
remediationItems.definitionOfDone: Required production dependencies are installed and used by runtime code.

remediationItems.title: Deployment, monitoring, backup, and recovery
remediationItems.description: Create repeatable staging/production deployment with env templates, health checks, logs, metrics, alerts, backup, restore, and rollback.
remediationItems.definitionOfDone: Staging deployment and operational readiness are verified.

remediationItems.title: Shared HTTP client cleanup
remediationItems.description: Configure the shared httpClient or remove it so production code cannot call a placeholder client.
remediationItems.definitionOfDone: No placeholder HTTP client remains in production paths.

remediationItems.title: Final launch hardening and signoff
remediationItems.description: Complete security hardening, staging verification, production dry run, observability tuning, restore drill, launch QA, launch signoff, and post-launch monitoring.
remediationItems.definitionOfDone: Launch readiness is evidence-backed and approved.

promptCoverage.verificationGate: Admin auth and API auth tests pass.
Public API has no seed imports and uses projections.
Live storage and hardened upload tests pass.
Analytics events reach provider or are explicitly disabled.
Staging deploy, backup, restore, and monitoring checks pass.
Shared HTTP client is real or removed.
